headline: THE LAUNCH YOU PROMISED FINALLY HAPPENED AND THE CLOSING YOU NEED STILL HASN'T — 225 Willow Point went live at 2:06 PM and the paid ad was running inside thirty minutes, while 5167 Lake Crest funds in twenty-one hours with a seventh straight verification finding no clear-to-close and the attorney's only word all week being that the buyer's figures changed. · DO: text Manda L. — are we clear to close at 3:00? · WATCH: attorney says buyer's numbers changed, 21 hours out (8/19).

notes: 🚨 THE BOOKS ARE NOW DAY EIGHT AND FOUR RULINGS ARE STILL STACKED BEHIND ONE SIGN-IN. The weekly bookkeeper stopped at its gate without doing anything because the accounting software is not signed in, and the money desk has now called that same software unusable eight runs running. A deposit list, a booking approval, a reclassification and a subscription dispute all wait on the same wall, and the bookkeeper does not run again until 8/24. ⭐ Still the one thing on this board that only you can unblock, and still one click.

🔍 THE SELLER-IMPORT DIAGNOSIS CHANGED THIS AFTERNOON, AND IT IS BETTER NEWS THAN THREE DAYS OF RED SUGGESTED. The 5:20 PM sweep got the property-data source to sign in successfully — so the lane is NOT dead and NOT blocked. It imported zero of twenty for a third day because the account is out of pull budget, not because the door is shut. That is a different problem with a different fix, and it is worth knowing before anyone spends more time on the wrong one.

✅ THE FLEET IS CLEAN AND THE WORK QUEUE ACTUALLY DRAINED TODAY. Every scheduled routine fired on time with no dark window, the automation platform is alive with no burst, and the text relay is healthy. ⭐ THE TWO GOOD NUMBERS: the call list went from fifty-nine at midday to forty-six tonight, and the draft folder went from thirty-five this morning to six with nothing aging. You worked this list by hand today and it shows on both counts.

callBlock.why: 🔴 DAY THREE, TWENTY-ONE HOURS OUT, AND THE ONLY MOVEMENT ALL WEEK WENT THE WRONG WAY. A SEVENTH independent verification this evening again found NO clear-to-close on any lane, and the relay that carried your outgoing texts all afternoon still contains no message from you to her. ⚠️ The closing attorney's single note today — at 12:39 PM, on the preliminary-policy thread — was that the buyer's figures changed. No detail, no follow-up since. ✅ VERIFIED AND STILL GOOD: preliminary title policy delivered, appraisal clean, repair addendum executed, septic long done, 3:00 PM Thursday cross-checked from three sources. ⚠️ The city inspector's sign-off still sits on closing morning. ⛔ Two texts settle the whole board — are we clear for 3:00, and what changed on the buyer's side.

🆕 THE NEWEST THING ON THE BOARD AND HE IS WAITING ON YOU RIGHT NOW. At 4:14 PM he texted “let me know when you have a second” — eight minutes after emailing that he would speak with his buyers about the inspection response. ⭐ THAT SEQUENCE IS THE WHOLE SIGNAL: he wrote, then immediately asked for the phone. The repair addendum and roof report went to his side at 1:21 PM today, so he is calling with an answer or with a counter, and either one is worth twenty minutes of your evening. ⛔ This is the only listing on the board where a live counterparty has explicitly asked you to pick up.

🔥 STILL THE LIVEST BUYER SIGNAL YOU HAVE, AND HIS TWO QUESTIONS ARE STILL UNANSWERED SIX HOURS LATER. At lunchtime he named his gap under the ask, told you to save his number as a standing investor, and wrote “Happy to have you represent me.” ⚠️ You answered him mid-afternoon about the house, but the two things he actually asked — is there room, and will you represent me — have not been addressed. ⭐ He is the only live buyer with a name attached anywhere on this listing, on the one address where two independent agent reads have already called the number too high. ⛔ One call does both jobs.

callBlock.who: Amy G. of Ethos International — 355 Comanche
callBlock.why: 🔥 DAY SIX AND UNCHANGED SINCE THIS MORNING. She filed Saturday night off that afternoon's tour: interested — YES, her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and have put it at the top of their list. ⭐ She is the same agent who phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so this is a returned call, not a cold approach. 🔴 THE HALF NEVER ANSWERED: she reported the basement lights would not come on — and buyers who have just started looking are touring other houses this week with a dark basement as their last memory of yours. ⛔ Call rather than write: the co-op mail lane is a deliberate hold, now day thirteen unruled, and the machine has not written to her by design.

🆕 HE REPLIED AT 5:00 PM WITH THE BIGGEST NUMBER ANYONE PUT IN WRITING TODAY. He described roughly twenty-five acres with water inside the interstate circle and wrote that it “could be $1m.” ⭐ THE BACKGROUND MATTERS: in January he told you “third quarter” — it is third quarter, he has been back on your site more than twenty times, and yesterday he moved his search off the Gulf Coast and into your home market. ⚠️ A reply draft is staged and unsent. This one has been warming for seven months and just named a price range on its own.

callBlock.who: Thomas D. — White Tail Run lots
callBlock.why: 🔥 HE ANSWERED “YES” IN WRITING AND ASKED FOR THE LOT LAYOUT AND THE PER-ACRE NUMBER — a specific, answerable request, now unanswered for four days. ⛔ This is not prospecting; it is a delivery you already agreed to make. ⭐ The land listing is the highest lead-producing thing you own, and he is the buyer who raised his hand on it fastest.

callBlock.who: James P. — 764 Miller Cir, Indian Springs
callBlock.why: 💰 HE TOLD YOUR OWN SITE YOUR ESTIMATE ON HIS HOUSE IS TOO LOW — and his is the largest of the three homeowners who did that this week. ⭐ THIS IS THE BEST-SHAPED SELLER LEAD PATTERN ON THE BOARD: a homeowner who disagrees with your valuation UPWARD has already decided his house is worth talking about, and he told you so unprompted. ⚠️ Two days old and still unworked.

💰 THIRD TIME HE HAS TOLD YOU THE ESTIMATE IS TOO LOW, AND THE CHANNEL IS THE POINT. Five emails have gone to him and produced zero replies — the mailbox is the dead lane here, not the interest. ⛔ Same upward-disagreement pattern as above, but with a proven answer: stop writing and dial him.

listings.status: ⏰ Under contract — funds tomorrow 3:00 PM, no clear-to-close after SEVEN checks, and the buyer's figures changed
listings.note: 🔴 NOTHING NEW ARRIVED THIS AFTERNOON, AND ON THIS FILE THAT IS THE BAD OUTCOME. The attorney's 12:39 PM line that the buyer's figures changed is still the newest word on the deal, and no clear-to-close has appeared on any lane in a seventh search. ✅ What IS done: preliminary title policy delivered, appraisal clean, repairs executed, septic complete, and the 3:00 PM Thursday time cross-checked three ways. ⚠️ The city inspector's sign-off is scheduled for closing morning, which leaves no slack if anything is short. ⛔ The two texts in your call block are the whole remaining job.

listings.status: ✅ ACTIVE $185K — went live at 2:06 PM today, and the ad was running within thirty minutes
listings.note: 🎉 THE RED ITEM THAT SAT ON THIS BOARD FOR A DAY IS CLOSED. The launch you promised on Tuesday afternoon happened at 2:06 PM Wednesday: three bed, two and a half bath, fourteen hundred square feet, end-unit townhome, seventeen professional photos and a floor plan, live on MLS. ⭐ The marketing did not lag the listing for once — the paid social ad went live thirty minutes behind it and runs through 8/26. ✅ The sellers already have the share email. ⚠️ TWO SMALL GAPS: the yard sign does not go up until tomorrow, and a fuller seller note is drafted but still unsent.

listings.status: 🔥 Under contract — inspection response delivered today, the other side asked to talk, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🔥 THIS WENT FROM THE QUIETEST FILE ON THE BOARD TO THE MOST ACTIVE ONE IN FOUR HOURS. The signed inspection addendum and the roof report went to the buyer's side at 1:21 PM. By 4:06 PM their agent wrote that he would speak with his buyers, and eight minutes later he texted asking you to call. ⭐ That is a counterparty moving, not stalling. ⚠️ Longest runway on the board at 10/23 — but the next move is a phone call tonight or tomorrow, not a wait.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — top of a buyer's list, the call is day six, and the seller answered the owner-financing question
listings.note: ⭐ THE PRICING QUESTION HERE IS SETTLED AND SHOULD NOT BE REOPENED — every agent read has either called it just right or declined to argue it. 🆕 THE OWNER-FINANCING FEELER RESOLVED IN TWENTY-ONE MINUTES: your seller will carry paper, but wants thirty to forty percent down against the buyer's fifteen to twenty. That is a real gap with a real conversation in it, and your counter is drafted and unsent. 🔴 THE UNFIXED THING IS STILL PHYSICAL: an agent reported the basement lights would not come on, and nobody has confirmed they work.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $550K — three agent reads call it too high, and the only live buyer named his gap
listings.note: 🔥 THE ONE ADDRESS WHERE THE MARKET AND A NAMED BUYER NOW AGREE. Last night's feedback made it the third read to say the price is too high; at lunchtime the buyer himself named a gap well under the ask and asked you to represent him. ⭐ An institutional seller is the most number-driven counterparty you will ever carry — three independent agent reads and a live buyer's stated number are exactly the evidence that moves one. ⛔ The call in your block is worth more than another price debate.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $162K — repairs agreed, financing gate shut this morning, closes 9/14
listings.note: ✅ TWO OF THREE GATES ARE BEHIND IT AND THE THIRD MOVED TODAY. The inspection contingency is removed and the lender's homeowners-association question — the one that could have stalled financing — was asked at 10:08 AM and answered by 11:49 AM. ⚠️ The remaining open item is paperwork rather than condition: initials promised on one paragraph over a week ago and still not delivered. Not urgent, but it is the kind of thing that is only cheap to fix early.

listings.status: ✅ Contingent — inspection and appraisal both cleared, closes 8/28
listings.note: ✅ BOTH GATES ARE BEHIND IT and the close date holds at 8/28. Nothing owed this week. ⭐ Worth noting for a different reason: this is the single closing in the last thirty days that traces back to a fleet touch at all — every other one is unattributed.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $184K — a “VERY interested” buyer, now ten days unworked
listings.note: 🔥 THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD IS STILL SITTING HERE UNANSWERED. Three forms came in within seventy minutes on 8/9 — two passes and one agent who answered the interest question with the single word “Very.” ⚠️ Ten days later nobody has called her. ⭐ It is a team listing rather than yours, which is exactly why it keeps sliding — and why one call would be unusual enough to matter.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — biggest listing in the book, zero showings ever booked
listings.note: ⚠️ NO TOUR HAS EVER BEEN BOOKED ON THE MOST EXPENSIVE THING YOU HAVE, and nothing changed today. 🔍 The comparable work already done says the ceiling for a big house on small acreage in this ZIP is well under the ask, and every sale above this number in three years carried seventeen to twenty acres. ⛔ This needs a pricing conversation with the seller, not more marketing.

listings.status: 🔥 Active — highest lead yield in the portfolio, and the septic answer is now day eight
listings.note: 🔥 THIS LISTING PRODUCES MORE LEADS THAN ANYTHING ELSE YOU OWN — four of the overdue calls in your list today came off it. 🔴 AND IT HAS AN UNANSWERED TECHNICAL QUESTION AT ITS CENTER: the septic/perc question has gone eight days without a reply, and it is the first thing a serious lot buyer asks. ⛔ Every day it stays unanswered, the leads this listing generates arrive into a conversation you cannot finish.

⭐ NEWLY VISIBLE RATHER THAN NEWLY SIGNED. Nothing is owed on it yet, and nothing is booked because it is not on the market. ⚠️ The useful lesson from Willow Point applies here: the gap that hurts is between “photos ready” and “live,” so the date to protect is 8/30 itself.

pipeline.note: 🟡 22 OF 45 AT DAY 231 — A PACE OF ABOUT 35 A YEAR, ON THE LINE RATHER THAN THROUGH IT. Nothing broke to cause this; a run of closing-free days did it, and that is the honest mechanism. ⚠️ THE ONE-DEAL DISAGREEMENT IS PRINTED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: this board and the money desk count 22 on the strength of a closing receipt, while the finance desk counts 21. The entire spread is a single file whose agent-of-record is contested — one conversation settles it, and until it happens every pace figure on every surface inherits the ambiguity. ⏰ THE WINDOW IS SHORTER THAN THE CALENDAR: at sixty to seventy-five days from contract to close, anything closing in 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31. That is ten weeks, not twenty. ⭐ THE THESIS WITH RECEIPTS IS UNCHANGED — the listings you already own generate more real conversations than any prospecting lane, and today proved it twice: the land listing produced four of your overdue calls and a buyer on your own listing asked you to represent him. 🔍 Figures last confirmed against the weekly forecast of 8/12; no newer forecast has been issued.

money.note: 🔴 A MONEY ALERT DID FIRE IN THE LAST TWENTY-FOUR HOURS — the money desk sent one at 5:32 AM against a bank-stamped balance, and it flagged a vendor charge posted the previous morning as the single largest avoidable item on it. 🔍 THE IRONY WORTH NAMING: that charge was for one of the two commercial listing sources that has refused this fleet seven consecutive times and remains frozen. 🆕 ONE GENUINE PIECE OF GOOD NEWS THIS AFTERNOON: at 3:32 PM the government lender ACCEPTED the re-amortization request — the hardship route was denied earlier, but this one landed. It is now document-gated rather than decision-gated, which is a much better place to be. 🔴 THE STRUCTURAL PROBLEM IS UNCHANGED AND NOW DAY EIGHT: the accounting software has been called unusable eight runs running, the books and the bank disagree with the bank as the authority, and four separate money rulings are all blocked behind one sign-in until 8/24. ⚠️ THE PLANNING ERROR STILL AVAILABLE: the largest closing on the board funds tomorrow but settles AFTER this week, and the attorney has said the buyer's figures changed — treating it as this week's cash was risky and is now worse. ⚠️ Figures, balances and account details are deliberately withheld — this page is public.

isa.decayPolicy: ✅ FORTY-SIX OPEN ROWS — DOWN THIRTEEN SINCE MIDDAY, AND THAT IS THE BEST DIRECTION THIS NUMBER HAS MOVED ALL WEEK. It ran fifty-nine at lunchtime; you worked it down by hand through the afternoon. ⚠️ SEVENTEEN ARE FLAGGED URGENT AND ALL SEVENTEEN ARE OVERDUE, the oldest by nine days — only eight fit on this board, so nine urgent rows are live and not shown here. ⭐ THE USEFUL DISTINCTION IS NOT AGE, IT IS DIRECTION: roughly a third of these are people actively waiting on YOU — a returned call, an answered question, a promise you made in writing. Those cost relationships. The rest are prospects to chase, and they only cost opportunities. 🔥 THE FRESHEST ROWS ARE THE BEST ONES AND THEY ARE STILL SELLERS: three homeowners this week disputed your own estimate on their own houses UPWARD, one of them near $1.9M and one of them for the third time. A homeowner who argues your number upward has already decided his house is worth discussing. ⚠️ And roughly a third of the list is still contactless address-only records queued for re-pull — the build that would turn them into named, callable people has now been the top queued build for eleven days.
isa.sweepCadence: every 30 min while the fleet is up — unbroken since midnight, sixteen passes today with no gap longer than eighty minutes. ⭐ THE PATTERN WORTH SEEING: five separate replies were caught within minutes of arriving today, and every one of them answered a note YOU sent by hand. The machine is not generating these conversations; it is catching them fast once you start them. 🆕 TODAY'S BEST SINGLE NUMBER: a brand-new seller lead went from arrival to a personal response in TWELVE MINUTES this afternoon. ✅ THE OWNERSHIP GUARD THAT FAILED ON MONDAY IS HOLDING — it correctly caught two more leads today that belong to a teammate and left them untouched, including one that your own ad had routed the wrong way. 🔍 TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND AND NAMED TODAY: the tool the sweep uses to read mail threads returns the OLDEST messages rather than the newest, which hid a lead for fourteen hours; and one late-afternoon pass called a lane dry with a live lead inside its own window. Both are logged rather than papered over. ⚠️ The thing to watch remains speed rather than accuracy: the instant-response lane only runs while the desktop app is open.
